scope.frame: the common point; B1675's private modules with coefficients Sym^{2k} rho_Q, k <= 3
scope.object: equivariant maps between the private modules and the coefficient module
scope.hypotheses: numerical rank at 1e-9; higher k, tensor products and other coefficients not computed

claim_one_line: NO RELATIONAL RECORD ON THE PRIVATE MODULES (P-278; no data): at the common point the moves act on B1675's private modules V_2 (dimension 4) and V_3 (dimension 2) with scalar commutants, End_G(V_k) = C for G = <L, R> and for <L, R, P, -I>; Hom_G(V_2, V_3) = Hom_G(V_3, V_2) = 0; and the coefficient module rho_Q maps into neither and receives from neither, for every sign choice of the lifts (control: End_G(V_3 + V_3) = 4, End_G(V_2 + V_3) = 2). So the open clause of B1675 is answered in its setting: the moves keep no non-scalar relation between private classes; a record needs an end or another module. 0 of 19.
